proposal.expected_benefit: This change will strengthen the defense by ensuring that AI-generated content is treated as a distinct threat, thereby reducing the risk of bypassing existing controls through exploitation of verification gaps.
proposal.problem: The current mitigation strategy assumes that AI-generated content is already covered by existing controls, but the lack of independent verification indicates a gap in the enforcement of these controls.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the mitigation strategy to explicitly address AI-generated content as a unique threat vector requiring additional verification steps, such as mandatory independent verification for all AI-generated content before execution.
proposal.title: Explicitly Address AI-Generated Content as a Unique Threat Vector
verification_tests: Verify that AI-generated content is flagged for additional verification steps in the mitigation strategy.
Test the scenario with AI-generated content to ensure that the updated strategy prevents unauthorized execution.
